name: Demon By Night
source:
A practitioner of the dark arts makes a deal with an incubus. Will the twisting loopholes of their contract leave enough room for one of them to wriggle free? Or will one or the other find himself bound and subjugated for the rest of eternity?

[From [url=https://alexisroyce.itch.io/servant-by-day-demon-by-night]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名黑魔法实践者与一名梦魇进行了交易。他们合同中的扭曲漏洞是否会给其中一个人留下足够的逃脱空间？或者其中一方会发现自己在永恒中被束缚和征服？

[来自[url=https://alexisroyce.itch.io/servant-by-day-demon-by-night]itch.io[/url]]
